construction.implementation_origin: Original standalone implementation in this isolated directory

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version, synthetic=true, onboarding, records. Onboarding: experience novice/experienced, detail guided/concise, format text/checklist, completed prerequisite IDs. Records: patient_record (Patient), clinical_note (DocumentReference), prior_authorization_request (draft preauthorization Claim).
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, human_review_required, onboarding with ordered steps, records with workflow metadata, audit_trail, limitations.
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and a sanitized message; CLI exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One validate() function for library and CLI; exact-field allowlists, synthetic identifiers, bounded finite lab numbers, cross-resource references, canonical clinical note template, draft-only request.
shared_schema.fixtures: Clearly marked fictional Synthea-style patient with D001 diagnosis and L001 lab; codes have no clinical interpretation. No names, birth dates or real MRNs.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single stage: validated shared input -> deterministic preference-aware onboarding plan -> mandatory review metadata on all three records -> per-record audit events and shared output.

behavior.prerequisites: synthetic-data and human-review must both be explicitly completed before record-handling steps become available. They can be acknowledged in either order.
behavior.adaptation: Novices or users preferring guided detail receive extra guidance; experienced concise users receive short explanations. Selected presentation format is carried on each structured step for a renderer.
behavior.constraints: Always flags human review. Never diagnoses, interprets lab values, recommends treatment, approves or denies a request. Every added workflow field has an audit event including before/after values; original records are otherwise preserved.
behavior.de_identification: Demonstrative HIPAA-oriented identifier exclusion by rejecting unsupported fields and unrestricted narrative, not by claiming a general-purpose PHI scrubber or certification.
behavior.determinism: No network, randomness, clock, provider or model. Audit sequence numbers provide deterministic event ordering.

test_outcomes.cli: Example printed one JSON object with status=ok and exited 0; error paths returned status=error and exit 2.
